name: redcafe-servidor
description: Red Café Ecuador — servidor Node + MySQL que reemplaza api/*.php manteniendo el mismo contrato

scripts.db:push: npm run build && prisma db push --skip-generate && npm run db:preparar
scripts.produccion: npm ci && npm run db:push && npm start
scripts.sql:esquema:
node -e "const{execSync:x}=require('child_process'),fs=require('fs');const f='prisma/esquema-mysql.sql';const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const cab=s.slice(0,s.indexOf('-- CreateTable'));const sql=x('npx prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script').toString().replace(/COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci/g,'COLLATE utf8mb4_bin');fs.writeFileSync(f,cab+sql.trim().replace(/
*$/,'')+'

SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS = 1;
')"
